admin.articlesEmptyDescription: Write the first article. It starts as a draft.
admin.articlesNeedCategory: Add a category first, then file articles in it.

admin.categoryGrantsHelp: Anyone who matches one of these. Applies to every article in the category; an article can narrow it further, never widen it.
admin.categoryNarrows: People must also see the category above it
admin.categoryNarrowsHelp: A category is only visible to people who can see every category above it.
admin.channelSmsHelp: Only people with a phone number who turned on texts for help articles get one.
admin.checklistArticlesDescription: In this order. People mark an article as read by opening it.
admin.checklistEmpty: No articles on this checklist yet
admin.checklistEmptyDescription: Pick the articles people have to read.
admin.checklistItemsSaved: Saved the articles of the checklist
admin.checklistLoadFailed: The checklist could not be loaded
admin.checklistsEmptyDescription: A checklist is a list of articles people have to read. You see who has finished it.
admin.createArticleDescription: It starts as a draft. Publish it when every language is filled in.
admin.createCategoryDescription: Create the category first, then file articles in it.
admin.createChecklistDescription: Create the checklist first, then pick the articles people have to read.
admin.deleteArticleDescription: It disappears from every page, checklist and search, and the record of who read it goes with it.
admin.deleteCategoryBlocked: It still has {count} articles. Move or delete them first.
admin.deleteCategoryDescription: Its subcategories move up a level.
admin.deleteChecklistDescription: People no longer see it. What they have read stays recorded on the articles.
admin.forbidden: You do not have access to the help center
admin.grantsInheritHelp: The article is visible to the people who can see its category. Turn this off to narrow it further.
admin.listDescription: Articles in categories, onboarding checklists and who has read what.
admin.loadFailed: The help center could not be loaded
admin.operationHelp: Leave empty for everyone. With an operation id, only people who take part in it see the checklist.
admin.ownerHelp: The platform, or an operation or team the category belongs to.
admin.ownerIdRequired: Enter the id of the owner.
admin.progressDescription: People who have started, and the ones the checklist's operation names. Unfinished first.
admin.progressForbidden: You cannot see who read what
admin.progressForbiddenDescription: It needs the help-center:pii permission, which no wildcard grants.
admin.sendDescription: People get a link to each article they are allowed to read.
admin.sendGroupsHelp: Everyone who matches one of these: a role, a team, the people who take part in an operation.
admin.sendNeedsAudience: Name at least one person or group.
admin.sendPeopleHelp: Search by name, or create a person who is not here yet.
admin.slugHelp: Lowercase letters, numbers and dashes. It is part of the address of the pages.
admin.slugInvalid: Use lowercase letters, numbers and dashes.
admin.title: Help center
admin.displayHelp: An article list links to each article. Questions open their answer in place, like an FAQ. Question cards show each article as a card of its own.
admin.iconHelp: An icon name such as i-lucide-info.
admin.articleIconHelp: An icon name such as i-lucide-info, shown next to the question.
admin.orderArticlesDescription: Readers see the articles in this order. Each move is saved at once.
admin.orderLoadFailed: The articles could not be loaded
admin.reorderFailed: Could not save the new order
admin.faqBodyHelp: In question cards the text before the first block is the card's description. A question that opens in the card: {details}, a list, then {end} on a line of its own. A button: {link}, then {end}.

faq.title: FAQ
faq.description: The questions and answers on the site's pages: the FAQ categories and their questions.
faq.emptyDescription: Add an FAQ category, then add its questions.
faq.question: Question

admin.fallbackToEmailHelp: People a text cannot reach (no phone number, texts turned off) get an email instead. Off: they get nothing.
admin.resultFallback: {count} of the emails went instead of a text.
admin.skipNoAccess: May read none of the articles
admin.skipOptedOut: Turned off emails for help articles
admin.changeKindToFaq: It moves to the FAQ admin, with {categories} categories and {articles} articles. Its articles become questions without pages of their own; their old links lead to the FAQ.
admin.changeKindToHelp: It moves to the help center, with {categories} categories and {articles} articles. Its questions become articles with pages of their own; their old links lead there.
admin.changeKindLeavesParent: It leaves its parent category and moves to the top level.
admin.changeKindChecklist: {count} onboarding checklist entries are removed: an FAQ question is never on a checklist.
admin.changeKindFailed: Could not change the kind of the category
admin.moveToFaqDescription: It becomes a question of an FAQ category, without a page of its own. Its old link leads to the FAQ.
admin.moveToHelpDescription: It becomes an article of a help category, with a page of its own. Its old link leads there.
admin.moveToFaqChecklistDescription: An FAQ question is never on a checklist: every checklist that lists this article loses it.
